articles.description:
A link between games.
Hopefully by now you've seen Zelda: Ocarina of Time in action on the Switch 2, and if you're anything like us, you were quite simply blown away by the sheer leap in visual quality when compared to the original.
To really demonstrate just how much the remake improves upon the N64 game, the lovely chaps over at GVG have provided a side-by-side comparison of the two games. Essentially, the same footage from Eiji Aonuma's gameplay demonstration is shown, but with similar footage from the N64 original playing next to it.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Video: Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Side-By-Side Comparison, Switch 2 Vs. N64

articles.description:
Dates in Edinburgh, Glasgow, Stockholm, San Francisco and more already revealed.
The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Concert will tour the globe starting in January 2027.
It'll feature music from the entire series - from "nostalgic tunes to modern melodies", according to an official blurb - and tour across Japan, North America, Europe and Australia.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Guide: All Confirmed Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Concert Tour Dates In UK, Europe, North America, Japan & Australia

articles.description:
Open your eyes... and look at these screens!
Well, that sure was a lot! As a part of today's Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct, we got our first extended look at The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Switch 2, and we mean an extended look.
Aonuma-san kicked things off with a full 15-minute gameplay session, followed by a new trailer that showcased... just about the whole game, it seems. A bunch of us here at Nintendo Life Towers were a little teary-eyed throughout the whole thing, truth be told, so we thought it was only right that we assemble the following gallery so we can all get a closer look at the damn thing.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Gallery: Here's A Closer Look At Zelda: Ocarina Of Time On Switch 2

articles.description:
How would you rate it?
Well folks, the first of two Direct showcases for this week is over, and boy was it a doozy.
It was a full 30 minutes' worth of delicious Zelda news, including the final release date for the hotly-anticipated Ocarina of Time remake for Switch 2.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Guide: Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct - Every Announcement and Trailer

articles.description:
And we want it all.
It all came in a somewhat 'blink-and-you'll-miss-it' sizzle reel in the 40th anniversary Direct, but Nintendo has a lot of merch in store to mark Ocarina of Time's Switch 2 release.
Aside from the Special Edition console and Pro Controller, there are also two new amiibo launching in 2027. The Young Link and Young Zelda figures show the iconic pair in their new art style, taking a seat and holding Navi and an Ocarina, respectively.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Nintendo's Rolling Out New amiibo And A Heap Of Merch For Zelda: Ocarina Of Time

articles.description:
Nintendo goes all-out.
In an age where physical media is on an unfortunate decline, Nintendo still knows how to keep its hardcore fans satisfied.
During today's Zelda Direct, the company revealed the box art for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the Switch 2. Rather than just slapping on some key art (gorgeous though it is) and being done with it, Nintendo has provided some special textured foil art for the release.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Switch 2 Price And Box Art Revealed

articles.description:
Get your Giant Wallet at the ready.
It's the one we've all been waiting for! Nintendo has officially revealed the Switch 2's first special edition console: a sweet 40th anniversary model to tie into the Zelda: Ocarina of Time release.
The special edition console will launch on 29th October, and it's a sweeeet one.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Zelda 40th Anniversary Special Edition Switch 2 Console & Pro Controller Launch This October

articles.description:
The GOAT, modernised.
Despite being revealed just a few months back, it feels like we've been waiting absolutely yonks for more information on Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the Switch 2.
Well, that wait is now over.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Launches On Switch 2 On 5th November 2026

articles.description:
Only a matter of Time.
What's this? A Nintendo Direct in September? Who would have thought it!
And so this week's dual Directs kick off. First up is a special anniversary show for Zelda's 40th, promising to deliver "a variety of information related to The Legend of Zelda".
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Watch: The Legend Of Zelda 40th Anniversary Nintendo Direct - Live!

articles.description:
If you like Piña Marauders...
I'll admit that I am relatively new to the Dragon Quest Monsters series. The Dark Prince passed me by on Switch, and while I have some memories of playing Joker on my DS, I never really "got into it" in the same way that I did the mainline games around the same time.
So, I was excited to find out more about Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World at a recent Square Enix event. My memories of the series were very much 'what if Pokémon were a little slimier', and I was keen to see if it had broken out of Game Freak's shadow in the years since, with 'mon-likes cropping up all over the place.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Preview: 'How Are Monsters Made?' & 5 Other Things I Learned Playing Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World

articles.description:
"I'm gonna s*** myself!".
Developer Atlantis Studio has released a new gameplay trailer for Beyond the Dark - Nightwatch, confirming that the title will launch on Switch 2 on 22nd October 2026.
We've already spoken with creative director Nico Augusto, and we're pretty chuffed with what we've seen so far, but this new trailer really demonstrates Beyond the Dark's unique gameplay mechanics quite well.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Beyond The Dark - Nightwatch Looks Like A Wii U Game In The Best Way

Two Directs in one week? Whatever will they think of next!

At the moment, the English patch notes have not gone live just yet, so we're working with a rough translation of the Japanese game page. According to this, there's a fix for an issue with the legendary birds, and various other bugs have been resolved to improve the overall experience.

The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct is just hours out, and Nintendo has shared a small update.
Ahead of this broadcast (and celebration) of the series, the company's Japanese social media account has teased what's to come. Unsurprisingly, it seems we'll be getting an update about Ocarina of Time for Switch 2, and there'll also be other initiatives featured that are not game-related...so, probably the movie!
Read the full article on nintendolife.com

Spoiler: It's really similar.
You'll no doubt be aware by now that Nintendo was recently forced to update the Switch 2 hardware in Europe to comply with new rules around replacement batteries.
Well, that new model is now available for purchase in multiple regions, and YouTube channel Nintendúo recently got its hands on one to showcase the differences. In short, there really aren't many to speak of, and at first glance you might not even be aware that anything has changed. But the devil, as they say, is in the details.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Video: Here's What Nintendo's Revised Switch 2 Console Looks Like

articles.description:
Series sales top 10 million.
Capcom – the publisher that can seemingly do no wrong right now – has announced that Onimusha: Way of the Sword has surpassed 1 million sales in its first day of release.
It's yet another remarkable accomplishment for the publisher; one that pushes the cumulative sales for the series over 10 million. By comparison, Pragmata surpassed 1 million sales in two days, while Resident Evil Requiem managed to shift over 5 million in less than a week.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com
articles.title: Onimusha: Way Of The Sword Sells 1 Million Copies In Just One Day

Nintendo's back with another eShop sale in the US, this time focusing on what it deems to be blockbuster games from the Switch 1 & 2. So in other words, these are bangers – especially since the following list is comprised of titles that we've awarded either 9/10 or 10/10. So you know you're in for a treat.

Read the full article on nintendolife.com
